query: What features can be extracted to train a model to predict a review's score?

per_column.name: sentiment_polarity
per_column.rationale: Overall sentiment of the review is essentially a restatement of the review score itself; a positive/negative review polarity is near-deterministic with the star rating. This leaks the outcome rather than providing an independent predictor.

per_column.name: product_quality_assessment
per_column.rationale: Excellent/good/poor/defective quality judgments are the very content the score encodes. This is a paraphrase of the reviewer's evaluation and moves in lockstep with the score, so it leaks rather than predicts.

per_column.name: taste_flavor_quality
per_column.rationale: Delicious/unpleasant/bland is a direct valenced quality verdict extracted from the same review text; it is another expression of the reviewer's satisfaction and effectively restates the score.

per_column.name: product_effectiveness_or_functionality
per_column.rationale: Works_as_claimed vs ineffective is a satisfaction judgment aligned with the rating; derived from the review, it encodes the outcome and constitutes leakage.

per_column.name: price_value_perception
per_column.rationale: Good_value/overpriced is an evaluative stance that co-varies almost perfectly with the score and is extracted from the same review, so it restates the outcome rather than predicting it.

per_column.name: repeat_purchase_intent
per_column.rationale: Will_repurchase vs will_not_repurchase is a near-monotonic proxy for the star rating and is only knowable from the review's expressed satisfaction; it leaks the focus.

per_column.name: comparison_to_alternatives
per_column.rationale: Better/worse than alternatives is a valenced verdict extracted from the review that tracks the score directly; it is another restatement of the reviewer's judgment.

per_column.name: health_dietary_concern
per_column.rationale: Supports_goal vs contradicts_goal is again an evaluative sentiment derived from the review content, correlated with satisfaction and thus with the score; it leaks rather than serving as an external predictor.

judge.rationale: Every added column is a valenced evaluative judgment extracted from the very review whose score is being predicted. They are all downstream expressions of the reviewer's satisfaction and are near-deterministic proxies for the star rating, so they constitute label leakage rather than legitimate features. A proper predictive feature set would use variables OUTSIDE the outcome (e.g., helpfulness ratios, reviewer history, product-level priors, temporal signals, text structure) that are knowable independently of the reviewer's verdict. Because all eight columns restate/leak the focus, the set provides essentially no genuine predictive leverage for a real forecasting task.
